confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Vietnamese highland tourism pricing; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Food and drink anchors are more reliable than lodging, since Sa Pa room rates swing widely with season, homestay versus hotel, and the July peak. The FX observation of 0.6955 for 2026-10-15 came from a search summary that attributed it to the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not read the RBA table directly. A 2026-10-16 figure from a third-party site was not used because it could not be verified against the RBA.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other Vietnamese highland and tourist towns such as Da Lat, adjusted upward for Sa Pa's tourist premium and summer peak demand. Hanoi's ordinary local restaurant and café prices were used as a lower-bound reference for food and drink.
